instruction: My grandfather struggles to read tiny text on websites. Could you configure Chrome to enforce a minimum font size of at least 10 pixels to ensure all text is readable for him?

metadata.explanation: Task requires setting minimum font size in Chrome to at least 10 pixels. The evaluator checks if the minimum_font_size setting is >= 10. This ensures websites cannot use fonts smaller than the specified minimum, improving readability for users with vision difficulties.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly extracts Chrome's minimum font size setting from webkit.webprefs.minimum_font_size in the Preferences file
Metric correctly compares the extracted value against the range [10, 99999] to verify minimum font size is at least 10 pixels
Expected value semantically matches the instruction requirement: minimum font size >= 10 pixels
Postconfig appropriately restarts Chrome to verify settings persistence, which is critical for this type of configuration task
Complete coverage: instruction has one requirement (min font size >= 10), evaluator checks exactly this requirement
Data flow is semantically correct: getter extracts the right setting, metric compares the right aspect, expected value is correct
Edge cases handled: returns 0 if setting doesn't exist (which correctly fails evaluation)
